line: Last time: a check said it passed. It lied.
Because nobody ever tested the check itself.
Here's the one test that proves a check is real.
Write one input you already know is broken.
Run your check on that, not on good input.
If it doesn't fail, the check isn't real yet.
Feed it a known-broken input. If it doesn't fail, it doesn't work yet.
Follow for setups that actually works.
